name: Solitaire TriPeaks Garden
author: Addicting Games
description: Solitaire TriPeaks Garden is a free Solitaire game. Welcome to the most romantic garden in the world. As the t-shirts say 'Gardens are for lovers.' Indeed. And we hope you love card games as much as you love your significant other, especially solitaire card games! That is what Solitaire Tri-Peaks Gardens is, a solitaire card game. It is in the genre of solitaire card games where you the player must use simple pattern recognition in order to make a pile of cards disappear. In this case, the pile of cards will be drawn one by one. If you do not see the card that you need, please, feel free to click through the deck until you do. But beware! This game is timed, it is scored, and for every card, you draw that you don't need you're really just pushing yourself farther and farther away from a high score. A high score can be shared with your friends and used to challenge them. So, put down that baguette and take off your beret. It is time to surrender to temptation and play Solitaire Tripeaks Garden.
